extraConstraints: This feature was reframed from the naive 'modify gig-cli.sh STARTUP' approach (rejected in §2). Verify the rejection reasons are concrete + no residual expectation that gig-cli.sh will be touched.

The pass_id lookup in REQ-R3(ii) scans tasks/*.json AND roi.jsonl for a requestId SUBSTRING match. Is this robust? Coconala requestIds are numeric like 5123100 — could this accidentally match unrelated numbers in the roi.jsonl outcome strings?

REQ-R4 unmatched-requestId-<x> sentinel format. When the reconciler sees this pass_id, does it correctly route to .unmatched.jsonl (reason='unknown-pass-id')? Verify against reconciler's REQ-R2/R7 semantics.

REQ-R5 dedup uses (requestId, earnings_status) against settle.jsonl tail. But settle.jsonl doesn't currently store earnings_status — it goes into evidence dict. Is that accessible for the tail-scan dedup?
REQ-M2 build_log outcome 'settle-mirror:new=N/dup=M/unmatched=K'. Confirm the reconciler's grep in feature (b) test_dispatch expects that exact format or is agnostic.
